query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_materials) as total_materials,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_material_molecules) as total_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT raw_material_id) FROM raw_material_molecules) as materials_with_links;
